scope: Documentation of accessible sources; not a new proof audit

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Exact physical-to-cubic source transport
entries.worked: The Pro20 record fixes R=X2², P=Y0Y1/(X0X1), U=Y1³/X1³ and Z=Y2/X2, with F=(R³/U)G. It carries the actual third-pole density, the coefficient functions of the plane cubic, and moving-root derivatives. The Weierstrass differential normalization is dx/(2y)=db/G_a, not the earlier factor-three convention.
entries.gap: No primitive follows just from presenting the source on an elliptic cubic. Physical transport and the nontrivial residue character must survive every subsequent step.
entries.scope: This is the common source binding used by several distinct architectures; it is not a certificate.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Direct q=1 deformation to q=2 and the character-2 companion bridge
entries.worked: The direct deformation produces a degree 72 denominator / degree 79 numerator partial current with exact F² error. Further corrections remove introduced K poles. A separate fixed-sextic q=1 companion reduction gives an exact formula converting a solution of its remaining q=1 equation into the desired q=2 current.
entries.gap: The retained R2reg or E_tot source is not integrated. Multiplying a previously accepted q=1 primitive by a source factor does not by itself supply the correct q=2 character or all derivative terms.
entries.scope: The bridge is useful reconstruction, not an existence theorem for its unsolved input.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: K3-transverse finite-b-pole and trace reduction
entries.worked: The supplied construction removes finite scalar b poles and a degree 12 trace, retaining the actual c1 b+c2 b² source. Two induced horizontal operator families and their literal currents are specified.
entries.gap: The remaining compact pair does not vanish merely because the scalar poles and mean trace have been served.
entries.scope: The transverse cubic reduction must not be conflated with the different proper18D two-parameter K3 module.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Three meromorphic forms: complete Hermite decompositions
entries.worked: The forms theta_j=b^j xi dζ, j=1,2,3, have a 72,373-node rational decomposition into finite 12 residues, infinity 2 residues, exact fibre terms, and compact amplitudes. The report specifies 282 inverse pivots and the actual origin-cover map.
entries.gap: Third-kind residues and the compact amplitudes remain genuine channels. They cannot be relabeled as exact rational fibre derivatives.
entries.scope: A decomposition into all channels is complete as a decomposition, not as integration of the whole source.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Moving-residue feedback and actual flux extraction
entries.worked: Known currents supply actual puncture fluxes. Moving third-kind sections give independent feedback into the two compact components; the appropriate feedback matrix can be inverted algebraically. The 8-stage upgrade keeps the full 44-input derivative recipe and all moving-section terms.
entries.gap: Differentiating source-dependent amplitudes reopens a residue error. A nonzero feedback determinant does not imply that this differential residual vanishes.
entries.scope: The two-family multiplier system is a sufficient search architecture, not a restriction imposed by the original target.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Same-elliptic-line diagonal current and odd-channel cancellation
entries.worked: The diagonal pair current has an exact additional vertical primitive C_odd/(4V) that removes its full odd-y channel. Pair-ordering trace and moving densities are retained.
entries.gap: The even source delta_ev is explicitly nonzero. Averaging the old and translated graph currents keeps that even term rather than canceling it.
entries.scope: Only the specified pair-ordering symmetry is traced; this is not permission to average away the physical character.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Coefficient-fibre norm-one density primitive
entries.worked: The actual coefficient frame and second-normal source are explicit. The audit extracts a nonexact Fermat-curve residue from an injective base-parameter expansion, avoiding specialization of an unknown primitive at its poles.
entries.gap: The two unchanged scalar kernel equations cannot both be solved within that density-only construction, even with arbitrary rational poles and compatible density gauges; normalized trace does not rescue it.
entries.scope: The audit expressly leaves coupled horizontal coefficient currents, other B channels, moving sections and new constructions available.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Six-component compact class, GL3 currents and scalar S
entries.worked: The consolidated report records the full source and 18 boundary outputs in a 1,905,243-node finite-algebra circuit. It gives g=(-S,0,0,0,0,0)+sum D_i B_i and S=N1931/(864 P^6 U^6 Z^3 K^4), with literal known boundaries and all three directions.
entries.gap: The remaining scalar class is not killed. Its reported small-ring obstruction concerns coordinate,K,discriminant poles, not every new support or the whole source localization.
entries.scope: The 1.9-million-node object is not the 119,215-node nine-class build or177,246-node physical Hermite circuit. The report was recovered here; that huge source payload was not newly rebuilt.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Genus-four 8+5 / 13D architecture
entries.worked: Worker A constructs the exact genus-four section and factorized generic8×8 compact connection. A conditional5×5 trace-zero residue block for a marked line is available. Worker C implements feedback handling, moving-pole reduction and bivariate solver machinery.
entries.gap: The actual physical8×5 feedback block, actual puncture divisor and complete generic13-component source are not supplied by the Worker A account. Worker C’s solved nilpotent-residue fixture is synthetic, not the physical source.
entries.scope: A modular 13-vector or conditional generic marked-line connection does not uniquely determine the full physical13D system.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Shared universal elliptic connection with reflection-residual
entries.worked: The project comparison identifies the universal rank-two elliptic connection through A_e=-I/3, B_e=-J/27 and a constant basis change. It also identifies a moving third-kind point.
entries.gap: The actual sources, incidence fields, pole orders and derivative couplings remain different. The reflection-residual current is not a cycle-q2 primitive.
entries.scope: Only source-independent identities may be reused without another actual-source adapter.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Character-preserving genus-two source and elliptic correspondence
entries.worked: The record keeps W³=T/R(T), obtains y²=z⁶+κz³+1, and constructs an elliptic correspondence whose projected2×2 matrix has determinant-12. A source-specific second-normal density and finite Hermite reduction retain all root and determinant jets.
entries.gap: The actual compact row is nonzero at a controlled characteristic-zero specialization. Its physical parameter-current equation remains unsolved, even though the curve character is reached.
entries.scope: The incidence-field amplitudes cannot be held constant as κ moves; that would change the source.

entries.group: A — Source-preserving reductions and reusable constructions
entries.title: Single-pair tangent and q=U scalar corrections
entries.worked: The old fixed tangent-section equation(E+12) for its delta source is excluded by an actual relative residue. The different q=U construction yields(E+9)(rho_U s)=−(H+10U)(rho_U d); for the changed source d=R2reg, the report gives a nonzero residue57 modulo 101 at a smooth transverse chart and a characteristic-zero lift argument.
entries.gap: Those individual correction equations do not have rational solutions for their stated sources. Allowing a finite separable extension does not repair the unchanged equations when normalized trace descends a hypothetical primitive.
entries.scope: The older delta source, small R2, multiple pairs and other current choices are distinct tests. Do not turn the new S-divisor residue into a global obstruction to the original target.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Critical-center blowup charts
entries.worked: The small R2 source is bound to the local center(K,C). On a specified Jacobian/discriminant unit chart, two explicit currents remove the exceptional double and logarithmic poles. Literal fibre corrections and Piola transport are provided.
entries.gap: A regular R_new remains. The other chart, overlaps, other pole supports and total source closure still matter. A second normalizer chart is not automatically the second blowup chart.
entries.scope: Local regularity along the finite-v chart does not establish global exactness or absence of poles at v=∞.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Elliptic-boundary ODE: erroneous obstruction withdrawn
entries.worked: The old multiplication coefficient index k was corrected to k+j. The ranks change from the claimed 85/86 contradiction to 85/85. An exact rational primitive with denominator degree 41 is reconstructed and independently checked; its associated two-component tangential current serves the K-boundary.
entries.gap: A nonzero regular compact source remains. The boundary primitive and a prepared Lean arithmetic checker do not prove the original target.
entries.scope: The former no-solution claim and dual functionals from the faulty assembler must not be used. This is an explicit correction in the source record, not an inference made while writing this document.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Reverse-point multiplier ideals: finite defect and transported source
entries.worked: The frontier report records J⊆I globally and equality on the coordinate boundary and center. It reduces the remaining defect to finite support and gives a 2706-dimensional retained source-character domain. It transports 90 original cocycle components with implicit-root derivatives and trace.
entries.gap: Finiteness does not establish nonemptiness or source membership. The open formulas invert the branch coordinate while the potential defect lies on its zero locus; that source-extension gap is material.
entries.scope: The domain dimension is not the dimension of the unknown evaluation target.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Seventy-two-point compact graph exclusion
entries.worked: The independent audit reconstructs a radical72-point compact scheme, including both spectral-root possibilities, and gives rational inverses of the two factors needed for a graph contradiction on that scheme.
entries.gap: The required saturated inclusion J⊆I:h^∞ from original gates to compact generators was not completed. The reverse inclusion I⊆J does not imply it.
entries.scope: No global empty-defect theorem is inferred here from the compact scheme alone. A timeout supplies no membership result.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Rounds 1–5 claim of empty reverse-point defect
entries.worked: The synthesis states that the off-center defect is empty and derives J=I, H¹=0 and a zero Gysin channel. It separately reports modular emptiness and several exact characteristic-zero subcalculations, plus zero traces in a stated untraced sector.
entries.gap: The same synthesis says the CRT cofactor lift for the missing reverse saturated inclusion was still running when stopped. The audit also leaves that transfer unresolved. These sources do not jointly supply a completed unconditional proof of the broad empty-defect claim.
entries.scope: Preserve both claims and the exact missing ideal-membership direction. Do not silently mark the entire reverse-point route either solved or globally impossible.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Polar, theta, exchange and native support exclusions
entries.worked: The source records report support-specific Hodge/Gysin exclusions: cross-Y polars, the original coordinate polar and discriminant companions, theta and exchange supports, constant-j and selected Kummer/bridge supports. The consolidated history retains the exact support transport and later scope updates.
entries.gap: None of these conclusions exhausts arbitrary new denominator divisors. Some summaries list only a support name; the detailed proof and its source-character assumptions must be retrieved before relying on it.
entries.scope: The atlas’s 50 physical equations and 48 native images are not counts of all geometric components. Fourteen selected native supports are a finite family, not all moving covers.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Critical branch versus cyclic cubic multisection
entries.status: PARTIAL / NEW CHANNEL OPEN IN RECORD
entries.worked: The consolidated report distinguishes the excluded branch D36=0 from the moving cover2U³+D36=0. It supplies a source-bound rank-four extension with proper2 and trace-zero residue2 components, encoded in 911 nodes with fibre witnesses.
entries.gap: The full three-direction equation is not solved. A theorem for the branch does not exclude the covering threefold or automatically compute its source image.
entries.scope: Likewise, the degree 108 physical coefficient cover and small unsuccessful rational-marking tests do not prove that no useful elliptic factor exists.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Contact-incidence continuation from a chain to the closed cycle
entries.worked: The record identifies the extra closing-edge compatibility equation and tests an enlarged space of projectively regular odd deformation directions. It exhibits a small separating functional and an exact kernel bound for the retained lifted seed.
entries.gap: The known meromorphic first-order correction has a pole at infinity. It is not the required regular family at λ=1. Source/Gysin evaluation on that nonexistent continuation was not completed.
entries.scope: Other seeds, larger properly controlled constructions and genuinely different closed-cycle families remain outside this failure.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Constant-j finite families and whole-current traces
entries.worked: The atlas records finite curve-family traces, including 240 roots and 2160 conic classes, with source and normal jets retained. Whole-form feedback traces and the stated CM support images were computed in the historical record.
entries.gap: The traced feedback did not close the actual source. An auxiliary polynomial primitive or a family seed alone does not provide the missing character-valued source contribution.
entries.scope: Normalized descent must act on the whole current with moving roots; it is different from an unnormalized sum of puncture residues.

entries.group: B — Moving divisors, boundary geometry and corrections
entries.title: Fold-parity Hankel elimination of the T=0 pole
entries.status: PARTIAL POLE RELOCATION; VERIFICATION SCOPE LIMITED
entries.worked: The Rounds 1–5 synthesis describes a five-term Laurent current with exponents−3,−2,−1,1,3 under D_N²−D_M D_K. Fold-sheet parity cancels the apparent resonances and removes the stated T-pole in the single e1 channel.
entries.gap: The construction transfers poles to(P² S1)E(T)=0. The other coupled operators have not closed that new transverse support. The explicit execution described in the synthesis is a formal Laurent-jet check over the finite field with 1000003 elements, not by itself a complete characteristic-zero coefficient identity.
entries.scope: Preserve the stated parity theorem and modular execution as different levels of evidence. No full original rational primitive follows from eliminating the fold pole.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Finite projection G=2t⁶+Bt+C and rank-five trace-zero system
entries.worked: On Y2=1 the source becomes8h t²/G³. The report gives universal rank-six connection and Hermite boundaries, then splits off the closed logarithm to a rank-five system in four base directions. A Bézout/norm replacement explains why arbitrary original fibre denominators can be represented by base denominators in this finite projection, retaining regular error.
entries.gap: The rank-five source-divergence equation is still unsolved. This finite-projection claim does not say that a proper elliptic or K3 cohomology module captures all possible extra residues.
entries.scope: The actual base dimension, residue module and localization are part of the equivalence; the word “base” has different meanings in different reductions.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Four-scalar cubic normal form and toric coefficient simplification
entries.worked: The four-direction cubic equation is reduced constructively to(E+4)U_E+eU_e+(h-2)U_h-(Y²+2p/3)v=g. A related retained 8-function system is reduced to 4 functions by an invertible beta,rho basis and toric variables that shorten W,V,L,J.
entries.gap: No rational solution is produced. The second-order scalar operator retains the difficulty of the eliminated components, and the full algebraic coefficient-field relations must not be dropped.
entries.scope: The E,h-only obstruction does not exclude the distinct e,h construction. The toric logarithmic twist(dlog A-dlog B)/3 is essential.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Generalized Hermite reduction to a rational ODE
entries.status: ALGORITHM / PROPOSAL; NOT COMPLETED ON TARGET
entries.worked: The architecture retains source reduction s=Er+∇μh and frame variation ∇λE=EC+∇μT. A rational solution of u′+Cu=r would reconstruct Jλ=Eu and Jμ=h−Tu. Worker C supplies moving-pole/curl identities and synthetic tests.
entries.gap: The complete target-specific reduction matrices and induced rational ODE were not obtained in the later proper-K3 attempt. Fixed-pole completeness must not be confused with arbitrary new pole support.
entries.scope: This describes a way to reconstruct a preimage, not a claim that one exists or that a solver has returned it.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: D-module / de Rham adapter
entries.worked: The project identifies localization, integration complexes, boundary maps and comparison/homotopy data needed to convert a source-class decision into an actual primitive. The formula Θ=ι(x)+h(σ) explains the necessary reconstruction witness.
entries.gap: The recorded full-source backend stopped during expensive Weyl-algebra normalization, before exactness or a rational preimage was decided. Merely calling deRham(F) or a holonomic solution command does not supply the six physical numerators.
entries.scope: Allocation failure, timeout and uncompleted class computation are operational results, not nonexistence theorems.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: HigherResidues and polynomial-curve machinery
entries.worked: The relevant machinery integrates the actual second-normal density when a compatible polynomial-curve family, normal, determinant jets and polynomial time density have been supplied. The characteristic root, finite descent, physical transport and regular quotient must all be retained.
entries.gap: The original source has not been shown to satisfy all such application hypotheses in a source-closing family. A theorem with those hypotheses is not an unconditional cycle-q2 theorem.
entries.scope: CFSG, AXLE and learned symbolic tools were investigated as supporting machinery or candidate generators; none supplied the missing original witness.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Full nine-class proper/infinity/branch equation
entries.worked: The 119,215-node2+2+5 system keeps the two proper elliptic channels, two infinity channels and five finite-branch channels, including every connecting matrix and all P,U,Z derivatives.
entries.gap: No arbitrary rational J_P,J_U,J_Z has been found that closes all nine equations. The system itself still represents specified punctures, not every possible new fibre-pole divisor.
entries.scope: A successful source fit for the proper block alone is insufficient; boundary conservation and full reconstruction remain mandatory.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Inverse-center and removable-pivot compression
entries.worked: The consolidated source history tracks actual inverse bases, scalar centers, exact quotient norms, a removable q37 factor, a genuine factor5695 pole and adjugate elimination of artificial pivots. It records generic producer-boundary identities rather than treating every Gaussian pivot as a geometric divisor.
entries.gap: Removing a representation denominator does not remove the compact source class. The full classification of remaining support factors is not supplied by the finite selected-support list.
entries.scope: Keep genuine source poles separate from artificial pivots and from optional poles allowed in a future primitive.

entries.group: C — Exact reformulations and algorithmic integration
entries.title: Earlier first-row, cofactor, scalar-gauge and ramification chains
entries.worked: The consolidated reconciliation reviews the M20–M31b chain of first-row currents, cofactor changes, scalar gauges, local ramification corrections and ninth-order actual-source jets. Later full-source and 910-node forcing records remove a generic source-expression gap.
entries.gap: None supplies a complete rational primitive. The reconciliation does not adopt the M28 zero-first-row restriction as an unrestricted theorem.
entries.scope: An explicit generic forcing expression supersedes a missing-expression problem, not the still-unsolved rationality problem. Individual missing worker payloads are not reconstructed from their names.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Degree-six character tests and genus-five necessary locus
entries.worked: The early second-jet report excludes45 pure nontrivial-character sectors and identifies an invariant genus-five candidate curve. An algebraic denominator passes two necessary gates.
entries.gap: Its explicit current still has error, and its full-system modular test fails. Passing Jacobian/second-order conditions did not establish F³ divisibility.
entries.scope: This older report explicitly leaves invariant and mixed-character cases open; see D02 for the later claimed stronger result rather than merging the stages.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Later complete degree-at-most-six exclusion for cycle-q2
entries.worked: The consolidated report’s “Unrestricted minimum denominator degree” section reports nine exact rational dual blocks,56 fourth-power eliminations and invariant moment/Bezout constraints yielding deg(D)≥7 for cycle-q2 over C, including mixed characters.
entries.gap: This is still only a lower bound. No successful degree ≥7 denominator is produced by it. The large proof payload was not replayed during this documentation task.
entries.scope: There is also a separate degree ≥7 report for reflection-coupled-residual. The cycle-q2 bound cited here comes from the cycle-q2 consolidated report, not that other target.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Degree-eight critical-Jacobian denominator
entries.worked: A direct horizontal V with V(B)=0 and div V=0 removes part of 8h t²/G³, leaving a displayed three-term residual. The natural D8 first-normal lift is explicit. 126 rational kernel relations match the 544 modular rank, while the augmented rank is 545.
entries.gap: That exact rank sandwich rejects every remaining correction for this particular D8 under its complete fixed-denominator formulation.
entries.scope: It says nothing about other degree-eight denominators or higher-degree/mixed supports.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: D20 complete solve and conductor adjoints
entries.worked: The full fixed-D20 system includes all six degree 27 numerators and unrestricted Q. It completes at three primes. A 44-term first lift and two small character-valued conductor residue forms are constructed; a smaller 2220-column family has an exact rational dual.
entries.gap: The full rational rank remains bounded between 20,996 and 21,256, so the modular 20,996/20,997 contradiction is not promoted to unrestricted characteristic-zero failure for D20. The conductor forms still need global extension and actual-source comparison.
entries.scope: Do not turn the smaller family’s exact obstruction into a theorem for the full denominator.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Ninety-three original-identity profiles
entries.worked: The reported complete profile list tests D=1,30 sextic-square and 63 quartic-cube denominators with full source-character numerators and Q. All served-source spaces coincide with a 58-dimensional baseline at p=101; a 24-term functional separates A.
entries.gap: No characteristic-zero reconstruction or matching global rank upper bound is claimed for the whole collection.
entries.scope: The useful no-repeat key is the exact support list and prime, not the slogan that all such degrees are impossible.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Actual compact source with delta and K poles
entries.worked: The actual generic source has 3594 and 2604 polynomial terms. Full three-direction searches use delta,delta K and delta K³. Two finite spaces have a rational kernel witness and a matching rank bound; larger 5011- and 13437-column results are modular only.
entries.gap: None returns a rational current. No statement excludes all numerator degrees for a given denominator solely from these finite spaces.
entries.scope: A separate irreducible cubic principal symbol blocks one proposed scalar diagonalization of the three-unknown architecture, not all integration algorithms.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Source-derived J³G_t³ finite-projection profiles
entries.worked: The finite-projection report solves a 1600-column and then a 10035-column forced-character profile; the latter has 13182 equations and a 7206-term independently checked dual at p=1000003.
entries.gap: The larger reported ranks 7876/7877 do not come with a characteristic-zero upper bound. No positive rational reconstruction occurs.
entries.scope: This remains a tested denominator/pole/numerator profile, not the unrestricted rank-five equation.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: One-coordinate rational integrations in the retained four-variable chart
entries.worked: Pole/infinity analysis gives finite complete rational forms for a single nonzero current in each of A,B,p,q. Exact Q systems have coefficient/augmented ranks 8/9,10/11,42/43,42/43.
entries.gap: None of those individual directions can carry the whole source in that chart.
entries.scope: Coefficients may depend rationally on the other variables, but coupled current rows and different useful directions remain available.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Added diagonal poles and S_c^m original-variable profiles
entries.worked: The record tests(p−q)^−1 and(p−q)^−2 with 2640 and 3960 unknowns, plus five S_c^m profiles directly in six variables with all N_i and Q. All reported tests complete modulo 103.
entries.gap: No candidate is found, and no rational rank bound is claimed for the five original-coordinate tests.
entries.scope: Increasing support or changing factors is outside the finite tests; repeating exactly the same profile is not progress.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Later large grid/cubic/fourth-power sweep
entries.status: HISTORICAL MODULAR SCREEN; PAYLOAD NOT RECOVERED HERE
entries.worked: The visible conversation reports 53 full-system runs,1369 two-coefficient choices modulo 37, quadratic-extension handling and a fourth-power system.
entries.gap: No positive certificate is reported. The exact profiles and executable receipts for those counts are not included in this source-only handoff.
entries.scope: Do not infer global nonexistence or use counts alone to decide a proposed support has already been exhausted.

entries.title: Initial Hessian inverse candidate
entries.worked: With H=Hess(F), h=det H, D=h and N=(5/24)adj(H)∇A, the first-normal equation is satisfied with degrees 24/31 and a legal denominator in the report.
entries.gap: The full defect retains F h² div((5/24)H^−1∇A). An exact algebraic-point calculation finds the remaining factor nonzero on F=0; the candidate fails.
entries.scope: Only this tuple and the additionally tested constant-density variations are rejected, not every numerator for h.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Second Hessian correction
entries.worked: The repair v=v0+Fw with v0=(5/24)H^−1∇A and w=(5/6)H^−1∇div(v0) cancels the first two normal orders. Explicit polynomials use D=h⁴, degrees 96/103.
entries.gap: The complete defect is F²D² div w, with a verified nonzero factor on F=0. The independent literal-E jet has a nonzero quadratic term, so no Q repairs it.
entries.scope: This is a higher-order repair of one construction, not a proof that arbitrary Hessian-supported currents fail.

entries.group: D — Denominator tests and exact failed candidates
entries.title: Logarithmic-gradient completion
entries.status: ACTUAL TUPLE AND FINITE FAMILY REJECTED
entries.worked: The explicit D=h²∏F_i and N_i=h(∏F_j)M_i+(F B0/6)∏_{j≠i}F_j have degrees 78/85 and serve the first two normal orders.
entries.gap: The literal E has a nonzero ε² coefficient at a good F=0 chart (64 modulo 101). A specified20-dimensional constant-coefficient completion family is also excluded by an exact rank argument.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Noncharacteristic local jets and finite b-adic currents
entries.worked: The earlier first-order physical-source jet reproduces all local equations. Attempt 70 computes a partial transverse current through the b⁴ source coefficient, retaining moving Γ_b; all eight compact basis positions occur across successive coefficients.
entries.gap: These finite jets are not an all-order rational current. They do not prove rational resummation, nor that the coefficient vectors span the whole eight-dimensional space.
entries.scope: Attempt 71’s further formal recursion is cited by later reports but its separate payload was not recovered here.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Attempt 72: Euler scaling curve
entries.worked: The exact source is put on a genus-seven scaling curve. Pole bounds reduce all rational primitives to 65 unknowns; a 97-row exact system has ranks 65/66 and a rational dual. A rational part plus nonzero compact remainder is reconstructed.
entries.gap: Integration along that entire specific scaling curve fails despite local formal solvability.
entries.scope: The report does not itself promote this one-orbit result to generic parameters; attempt 73 addresses that separately.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Attempt 73: generic Euler-only rationality
entries.worked: Global pole bounds give48 coefficients over the transverse parameter field. A universal constant-primitive kernel bounds rank by 47; a nonzero 48×48 augmented minor (32 mod101) establishes generic inconsistency. Normalized field trace excludes finite-extension rescue of that same equation.
entries.gap: The Euler-only formal solution does not rationalize.
entries.scope: Currents using the transverse ratio, Z or b are not excluded.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Attempt 74: Nambu tangent fields and U motion
entries.worked: An exact Bézout construction supplies a polynomial-in-Z tangent field S with S_U=1. Together with T it gives a free rank-two tangent module over Q(P,U,b)[Z] and source-serving moment currents.
entries.gap: The full divergence leaves g0+T(φ)+S(ψ)+ψ div S. No rational φ,ψ solving this expression is produced.
entries.scope: The polynomial-Z,k2-only class is not every rank-two or physical current. The report also flags old attempts53/54’s omitted Z product-rule term.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Attempts75/76: scalar B-correction equation
entries.worked: Attempt 76 clears the 12×12 Sylvester inverse denominators in Bψ+(div B)ψ=−g. It includes all moving derivatives. Prolongation gives an exact generic contradiction for every polynomial-in-Z ψ of degree ≤5 with arbitrary rational coefficients in P,U,b.
entries.gap: The previous leading correction −b³g2/3 fails the complete scalar equation. Higher Z degrees and genuine Z-dependent poles remain untested by that theorem.
entries.scope: The nonzero 61×61 augmented minor is a characteristic-zero positive-minor argument with a 60-column bound, not mere modular rank failure. The attempt 75 dependency is inherited.

entries.group: E — Later local, scalar and cross-area attempts
entries.title: Attempt 77: Hamiltonian plus elementary transverse moment lift
entries.worked: A divergence-free Hamiltonian current serves one moving cubic moment. An explicit W=P^−5(P∂P+3U∂U+2Z∂Z−b∂b) and ψ=R_q/W(q_c) serve both moments. The new τ=3Z⁶+(U³−U)b³−1 factor is a genuine pole in that current. The report independently rechecks source transport.
